messages:
Alice: FYI planning to promote v2.3.1 to prod at 2026-03-18 16:00 PT. Need smoke owners, rollback slot, and CS/marketing heads on standby. Deploy will be done by @Bob from eng-releases.
Bob: I'll own the deploy. ETA 16:00 PT, 30m window. I'll run smoke checklist and post results.
Laura-CS: We'll prep KB update and standby for customer inquiries. Please send release notes by 15:30 PT.
Mike-Marketing: I'll queue the launch banner and tweet draft. Send final copy by 15:45.
Carla: QA smoke owner here. I'll run sanity flows, auth, embeddings endpoint, rate-limit checks.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Started canary rollout to 2 nodes. canary_id=canary-887
Alice: Good. Bob, add a canary + auto-rollback if error_rate>2% within 5m. Confirmed?
Bob: Set. auto-rollback enabled. I'll monitor metrics and kvcache hit-rate.
Eve: Note: dedicated pool scheduled to scale at 15:50 PT; can cause transient throttling. Plan to pause autoscale during deploy?
Dan: Recommend pausing autoscale 15:45-16:15. I'll handle infra toggle.
Laura-CS: If rollback happens, we'll open an incident channel and notify customers on the affected orgs list.
Mike-Marketing: Also hold off external announcement until you say 'go' explicitly. We'll wait for smoke pass.
Bob: Pre-deploy checklist: 1) migrate config flag off, 2) clear prefix cache, 3) run smoke tests -> will post results.
Carla: Running smoke now against stage -> pass for generation, failure on reranker 502 intermittently. Investigating.
Bob: Hmm. Can you paste logs?
Carla: ```http 502 POST /rerank  (trace=xyz)
stack: upstream timeout```
Alice: If reranker unstable, we can promote model without reranker by flipping route to v2.3.1-no-rerank as temporary variant. Thoughts?
Laura-CS: OK for customer-facing if we note in KB that reranking might be delayed. Prefer avoid rollback if functionally acceptable.
Dan: infra: we can route traffic to no-rerank variant at the LB level for first 10m then re-enable.
Bob: I'll coordinate. Assuming the rerank fix takes >1h, proceed with no-rerank variant and incremental canary.
Mike-Marketing: Noted. We'll update messaging to say 'reranking temporarily disabled for better stability' if needed.
Alice: Final ask: post release notes (bullet list), marketing copy, and CS notify by 15:40 PT. Confirm you're all set.
Laura-CS: Will deliver KB draft at 15:30.
Mike-Marketing: Copy in #marketing-review by 15:35.
Bob: Deploying canary at 16:00. Will update thread with pass/fail and final promote time.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary healthy after 5m. error_rate=0.3% latency_p95=120ms
Bob: Promoting to 50% now.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Promotion to 50% successful.
Carla: Smoke at 16:12: all checks green. reranker still flaky but using no-rerank variant, end-to-end ok.
Alice: Go for full promote at 16:20. Marketing hold lifted.
deploy-bot: :tada: Full promotion complete. version=v2.3.1-no-rerank
Bob: Rolling back autoscale pause at 16:25. Monitor for 15m.
Laura-CS: KB published and CS notified. Support triage on standby.
Mike-Marketing: Tweet scheduled and sent at 16:30.
Alice: Thanks everyone. Postmortem if any regressions. Closing thread.
